summary: Module-Based Admin Access Control feature testing completed. All backend API tests (15/15) and frontend UI tests (12/12) PASSED. The new module-based structure has 3 modules: Dashboard (6 items), Capex Request (10 items), Analytics (6 items). Each module has a master toggle, and items have toggle, permission buttons (View Only/Editable/Hidden), role toggles (6 roles), and user override support.

issues: Console warnings about HTML hydration errors: '<th> cannot be child of <span>', '<td> cannot be child of <span>', '<tr> cannot be child of <span>' - this is a React hydration warning that should be investigated but doesn't affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Console warnings about HTML hydration errors in Dashboard.jsx table - '<th>/<td>/<tr> cannot be child of <span>'. This is a React hydration warning that should be investigated but doesn't affect functionality.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Access Control feature fully tested with NEW MODULE-BASED structure: 1) GET /api/admin/access-config returns 3 modules: dashboard(6 items), capex_request(10 items), analytics(6 items). 2) PUT /api/admin/access-config saves module updates with new payload format {modules: [{id, enabled, items: [{id, enabled, permission, roles, user_overrides}]}]}. 3) POST /api/admin/access-config/reset resets to defaults. 4) Non-admin users get 403 on admin endpoints. 5) GET /api/access/permissions returns module-based permissions {dashboard: {item_id: permission}, capex_request: {...}, analytics: {...}}. 6) Admin gets 'editable' for all items. 7) Buyer gets buyer_module=editable, capex_head_module=hidden, buyer_performance_chart=hidden. 8) Frontend Access Control tab shows 3 module cards with item counts. 9) Module toggle disables all items under it (shows 'Module disabled' message). 10) Each item has toggle, permission buttons, role toggles, user override section. 11) Save Changes and Reset buttons work correctly. 12) Buyer dashboard renders correctly with permissions applied.
